# Geometry Wars 2 PC Plus v0.10.1

**Faster on laptops, and a Discord.** This is an unofficial fan-made port, not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's makers or publishers, and **no game files are included**: you need your own Xbox Live Arcade package.

## Laptop or Intel graphics? Try this first

In the launcher, open **Graphics** and set the new **Render path** to **Fast**, then press **PLAY**.

On Intel graphics (most laptops without a separate graphics card), the game has until now always used a slower way of reproducing the Xbox 360's graphics memory. Measured on the same replay, that path cost **34 to 45% more GPU time**. **Fast** uses the quicker path every other GPU already uses.

The slower path was chosen for Intel years ago because of an old Intel driver problem, and it hasn't been tested on today's drivers yet. So Automatic stays as it was, and the launcher shows a hint on Intel machines. **If anything looks wrong with Fast** (flickering, trails, a black screen), set it back to **Automatic**. Either way, please tell us how it went on the [Discord](https://discord.gg/ZJtcwYPN7): once a few Intel players confirm Fast looks right, it will become the default there.

## What's new

- **Render path** in Graphics: Automatic, **Fast** or **Compatible**. A change restarts the game once when you press PLAY.
- **A Discord** for PC Plus: a **Discord** tab at the bottom of the launcher, and a link in its header. Come and share scores and custom modes: https://discord.gg/ZJtcwYPN7
- **Your player name** is shown in the launcher's header, after the title, as the leaderboards show it.

Everything from v0.10.0 is still here: custom modes, replays, the results screen, online leaderboards and nearby players.

## Installing

1. Download **GeometryWarsRetroEvolved2-v0.10.1-windows-x64.zip**, extract it anywhere you can write to, and run `geometry_wars_retro_evolved_2.exe`. Updating: extract over your current folder, or use the launcher's update.
2. On the **Play** page click **Install from package...** and pick your Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 package (Title ID `584108FF`, game version 0.0.1.2).
3. Press **PLAY**.

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), a DirectX 12 graphics card and the latest Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64) are needed. The build is not digitally signed, so SmartScreen may warn: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
